Locked-off camera, framing holds. He performs from the first half-second, sharp moves on the beat: on the first beat his outstretched arm sweeps palm-up, presenting the car body like a showroom host; on the next his near glove pinches thumb and finger almost shut at the lens; then a flat-palm chop down; then both shoulders up in a slow sarcastic shrug; then a deep nod, chin down. His hands stay below his chin. The worker keeps tightening his bolt, never looking up. Knitted mask, gloves and suit unchanged. SFX: ratchet clicks, cloth rustle, factory hum.

Thanks.
